Noah: Short live thread for follow-ups from all-hands about GTM, pipeline hygiene, and partner enablement. Keep Qs tight and actionable.
Emma: Key asks: 1) partner scoring rubric will land next week, 2) prioritize co-sell for partners that drive >250k ARR-equivalent, 3) tighten lead handoff SLAs.
Ravi: Quick question on ARR: do partner-led proofs count toward the threshold or only signed ARR? @Emma
Emma: Prefer signed ARR, but approved proofs that convert within 90 days can be escalated as exceptions with RevOps sign-off.
Priya: Partner ops note: were rolling a minimal joint-POV checklist + security attestation. Partners must complete that before co-sell commit. Ill upload template here tomorrow.
Diego: Marketing asked about co-marketing credits and MDF for the pilot. Any ballpark numbers?
Emma: Pilot: small co-marketing stipend + prioritized listing in partner portal for Gold-tier. MDF will be considered after pilot metrics (engagement & closed-won).
Sam: CS needs onboarding SLAs for partner-influenced deals to update runbooks. What should we assume for playbook edits?
Priya: Baseline onboarding SLA 30 days. For partner-prioritized deals we can aim for 14 days if partner provides a named PoC and the joint-POV within 5 business days.
Lena: Ops action: Sales to tag partner-influenced opps with `partner-led` or `partner-influence` in SFDC by COB Thu. RevOps will validate and notify Finance for forecasting.
Ravi: Ill start tagging and backfilling open opps. Can we get a one-pager with scoring levels and approval path?
Noah: Yes — please post a concise one-pager (bullets only) + the SFDC tagging steps in this thread by EOD tomorrow.
deploy-bot: Notes & recording uploaded: https://redwood.internal/all-hands/1955554321
Emma: Leadership ask: escalate any deals needing exec involvement by Friday to #sales-escalations and DM me.
Noah: Thanks all. Post only short status updates after tasks are complete and tag @Priya/@Emma for blockers.
